correctness.rationale: For reflection f(e^{iθ})=e^{-iθ} on the geodesic unit circle, deg(f)=-1 and f fixes 1. Any homeomorphism identical on a nondegenerate arc must preserve orientation (an orientation-reversing lift is strictly decreasing and cannot fix an interval) and therefore has degree +1. A uniform distance below π gives a continuous shortest-geodesic homotopy between f and proposed perturbation, contradicting degrees. Independently substituting reflection into source interpolation gives g0(θ)=(1-2ρ(|θ|))θ; as ρ passes 1/2, g0(s)=g0(-s)=0, violating injectivity. Applies to arbitrarily small perturbation lemma on S¹; no inference that the final density theorem is false.
